extras.textures: PBR 4096px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: stylised cruise ship shortened to 70 m (real cruise ships are ~250-360 m): approx. 71.5 x 14.3 x 31 m (L x W x H), 5 superstructure decks
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 3.3 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); balcony rows stylised as dark window bands with white rails; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: cruise-ship_propeller_port / _starboard (spin around the shafts), cruise-ship_rudder_port / _starboard (turn around Z); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no name, no flag

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
